mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.producer_id AS producerId, s.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, s.store_name AS storeName, s.phone AS phone, s.addr AS addr, s.addr_detail AS addrDetail, s.region_si AS regionSi, s.region_gun AS regionGun, s.description AS description, s.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, s.status AS status, s.is_active AS isActive, s.created_date AS createdDate, s.updated_date AS updatedDate FROM store s WHERE s.producer_id = #{producerId}
